design_philosophy: Swiss & High-Contrast. Authority, Clarity, Truth. We are building an AI website builder that feels like a precision engineering tool. Minimalist, function-first, with sharp edges, deep blacks, and electrifying cobalt blue for action. The UI should get out of the way to let the generated websites shine.

spacing_and_layout.marketing_bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 md:gap-12
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

instructions_to_main_agent: MANDATORY: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing pages (Landing Page) to achieve bento grid asymmetry. Do not restrict yourself to Shadcn cards there.
MANDATORY: Use Shadcn UI for the Dashboard, AI Business Wizard, and Publish Flow, but customize them by setting rounded-none and using crisp 1px borders.
MANDATORY: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) using kebab-case role-based names.
MANDATORY: The hero section must have a stark, high-contrast headline without generic gradients. Let the typography do the heavy lifting.
MANDATORY: For partner/customer logos on the landing page, use typography-based logos (e.g., 'ACME Corp' in font-black text-gray-300) rather than generic placeholder images.
MANDATORY: The AI Wizard should feel like a 'Control Room'. Dense, high-contrast, functional. Use pure black or electric blue for active states.
MANDATORY: Ensure a persistent, visible navigation bar across the site with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) if content scrolls underneath.
MANDATORY: All hover states must explicitly define text colors to prevent invisible text on dark backgrounds.
MANDATORY: Use 'Outfit' for all Headings (H1-H4) and 'IBM Plex Sans' for Body text. Import these from 'next/font/google'.
